settings.container_note: Timed runs write unencrypted CTB v4 for Jupiter and Saturn 2, and GOO for Mars 5, so UVtools can read both engines. Catalog native containers are probed separately. Catalog mirror flags are not applied; both engines are asked not to mirror.

box.note: Axis-aligned 20 x 16 x 12 mm box, centred on the plate, sitting on the bed.

asymmetric.note: 30 x 20 x 4 mm slab with a 10 x 8 mm tower on the +X +Y corner, from z = 4 to z = 12. A mirror or a Y flip moves the tower to another corner.

sculpt.note: Height-field solid, 48 x 40 mm in XY and exactly 20 mm tall, with two smooth bumps. Generated here; the repository had no mesh over 900k triangles.

header_with_machine_height.note: One file each, not part of the timed medians. Metadata added printer.buildVolumeMm.height, ctb.bedSizeZ for the CTB file, and goo.antiAliasingLevel 1 for the GOO file.

bed_rectangle.note: 260 x 140 x 0.2 mm slab on Jupiter, 4 layers, 3 cold and 3 warm. A large simple rectangle, not a dense mesh.

sculpt_scaled_to_bed.note: The 906300-triangle sculpt scaled in XY to 240 x 140 mm, height still 20 mm, Jupiter, 3 runs with the process already warm. Not a cold/warm pair.
